Run Katch in PiP mode while watching K-pop videos, K-dramas, or Korean movies. The app listens to the Korean audio through your device's microphone and translates it into text on your PiP screen.

2) Real-Time Voice-to-Text Translation
Katch captures Korean spoken words in real-time and provides a running text translation in your chosen language.

3) Synchronized Subtitles
Enjoy your video with our synchronized subtitles that appear as you watch.

4) Language Customization
Choose the language you want your Korean audio to be translated into.

Katch's user-friendly design ensures that you can set up and start using the app in a matter of seconds.

Katch only listens in when you activate the app, ensuring your privacy is respected at all times.

Be in the loop anytime, anywhere with your ultimate K-culture companion, Katch!
